subject: SparkPilot POC — throughput & cost recap and quick reference ask
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Elise Carter <elise@finmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SparkPilot POC — throughput & cost recap and quick reference ask

Hi Elise,

Thanks again for running the SparkPilot last month — excited with the numbers and wanted to share a short recap and a quick ask. Attached is a 1-page summary (spark-poc-results.pdf) and a chart of measured throughput across the test window (throughput-chart.png).

High-level outcomes from the two-week POC (75k requests, mixed-length conversational prompts):
- Avg latency (p50): 140 ms (13% improvement vs baseline infra)
- Avg latency (p95): 370 ms
- Throughput: sustained 620 requests/min on the configured Dedicated pool (40% higher than your prior setup)
- Cost per 1k tokens: $0.68 (projected steady-state after caching & batching) — ~28% reduction vs baseline
- Accuracy/quality: identical to baseline on the sampled regression eval set (N=500)

Those improvements were driven by a few runtime tweaks we made during the pilot: prefix KV caching on frequent sessions, and a tighter batching window for medium-length conversations.

Quick ask: Would FinMart be open to a short one-sentence quote we can use (e.g., 1 line for a case snippet) and a 15-minute recorded call with a marketing PM to record 30–60s of audio? We can provide suggested one-liners you can edit. If helpful I can also pull together a one-line suggested blurb for legal to approve.

Proposed 15-minute slots: Thu 11/19 10:00–10:15 PT, Thu 11/19 14:00–14:15 PT, or Fri 11/20 09:00–09:15 PT. If none of those work, tell me a window that does.

Thanks,
Maya

--
Maya Srinivasan
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: spark-poc-results.pdf (1 page summary), throughput-chart.png (PNG chart)

2) Technical (case/internal use): "By enabling prefix KV caching and workload-aware batching, we sustained 620 req/min and reduced steady-state token cost by 28% compared with our prior configuration."

Suggested attribution format: "Elise Carter, VP Engineering, FinMart" — tell us if you prefer a different title/format.

Marissa (cc’d) — if legal signs off quickly we’d love your help drafting a 1-page case brief and a short landing blurb.

If OK, I’ll attach the brief to the calendar invite and we can record 30–60s of audio during the 15-minute call (only if you’re comfortable).

Thanks — see you Thu.
